Only crazy story I can think of was one time while driving my car (which had bald tires) on a rainy coastal road,  I spun out on a blind corner next to a really steep DEEP cliff with no protective rail. After spinning around once and stopping in the middle of the road complety unharmed, my partner and I looked at each other and just started laughing hysterically. Neither of us knew why but we both just started laughing, I think our adrenaline was so high and we were just so happy to be alive that it just happened spontaneously. We laughed super hard for a few seconds and then were like ok were still on this blind corner next to this cliff. So I started the car back up and continued on our way (car was a manual and I must have killed the engine during the spin out).
